description: This file defines a Python class 'ArizePhoenixClient' that provides methods to interact with the Arize Phoenix API, including fetching prompt versions and testing the connection. It handles authentication, API requests, and error handling.

classes.name: ArizePhoenixClient
classes.description: Client for interacting with Arize Phoenix API to fetch prompt versions, handle authentication, and manage HTTP requests.

methods.name: __init__(self, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Initializes the Arize Phoenix client with API key, base URL, and sets up headers and HTTP handler.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_prompt_version(self, prompt_version_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a specific prompt version by ID from Arize Phoenix API, handling different HTTP error responses.

methods.name: bool test_connection(self)
methods.description: Tests connectivity to the Arize Phoenix API by making a request to the prompt_versions endpoint.

methods.name: close(self)
methods.description: Closes the HTTP handler to free up network resources.
